decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): On its own, the cited excerpt is only the list item "component" [ev-73d501ad9fa3]. The section around it [ev-b07a4021f30c] explains it: Loki 3.0 automatically adds a `service_name` label to ingested logs by default. It takes the value from the first matching label in an ordered default list, and "component" is 10th in that list, after service_name, service, app, application, name, app_kubernetes_io_name, container and container_name [ev-92063a2a5bac, ev-2690c7915f58, ev-61d6d2b50a95, ev-c8bbef5b1d06, ev-d0c9247a44d4, ev-33c9df8cd833, ev-ba4422942cd3, ev-6c97458131e0]. If no label matches, the value is `unknown_service`. Logs that already have `service_name` are left alone, and operators can change or disable the list with `discover_service_name` in `limits_config`. That is concrete enough to write the subject, change, applicability and consequence, though this item is just one entry in the wider `service_name` change.
